name: qoliber/trident-symfony
description: Symfony bundle for the Trident HTTP cache: durable tag purges from Doctrine changes (outbox in the same transaction), bounded cache-tag headers, a FOSHttpCache proxy client, the admin screens' logic over the shared Trident admin client, and the security defaults (token sealed to its URL, env token only to env URLs, no link-local/metadata targets).

suggest.friendsofsymfony/http-cache-bundle: ^3.4 — Trident as FOSHttpCache's proxy client (tags, clear) when the app has none
suggest.doctrine/doctrine-migrations-bundle: ^3.2 — the bundle's migration for its two tables (otherwise doctrine:schema:update from the entity mapping)
suggest.symfony/scheduler: drain the outbox every minute from a worker (messenger:consume scheduler_trident)
suggest.symfony/security-bundle: the login marker (trident.login_marker): signed-in visitors bypass Trident, and their renders are never shared
